name: enrichment guard never fires, so verify_bid bookings reach DSS without isPartnered/amountUSD
guard keys on truthiness not presence, so a known-unknown isPartnered=None is re-queried every run
candidate_state check inverted, so candidates are enriched and real matches are not
find: return bool(booking and not candidate_state and booking.get("id")
replace: return bool(booking and candidate_state and booking.get("id")
